summary: Narrow regression after deploy/run.bat packaging-only fix (Windows batch cd to backend dir before uvicorn). Confirmed zero app-code regression: /api/health returns status ok with simulator=true and fresh last_packet_age_sec (~0.06s); WebSocket /api/ws/heading streams at exactly 10 Hz (20 frames / 2s) with numeric heading/rot/cog/sog (plus ts, sentence, stale, age_sec, simulator, udp_port); GET / serves the static React build (HTTP 200, text/html). Frontend at public URL loads with SIM badge, LIVE green status, compass rendering 279.8° TRUE, COG 281.9°, SOG 4.4 kn, ROT 22.0°/min STBD, HEVTG sentence in NMEA footer, heading history chart polyline visible. deploy/run.bat fix reviewed: `cd /d %~dp0..\backend` is correct - resolves to sibling backend/ dir regardless of invocation cwd. No new pytest run needed (v1/v2 suites unaffected per request).
critical_code_review_comments: deploy/run.bat fix is correct and minimal. %~dp0 always ends with a backslash so %~dp0..\backend resolves cleanly. `cd /d` handles drive changes. No app code touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 was a scoped regression check for a Windows batch script fix. App is unchanged and fully healthy. Pre-existing minor items from iteration 2 (2 flaky legacy tests in test_gyro_repeater.py; harmless hardcoded '±5° auto' label in HeadingChart) still apply and were NOT re-verified.
rca of the issue: Original bug: deploy/run.bat lacked cwd change so `python -m uvicorn server:app` ran from deploy/ where server.py doesn't exist. Fix: `cd /d %~dp0..\backend` before launch. Verified logically; not executable in Linux container.
